hero.title: Pizza that loves you back.
hero.lead: Slow-risen sourdough, fresh toppings and a Mediterranean-diet state of mind. Takeaway, minus the fast-food reputation.

story.heading: Takeaway pizza deserves better.
paragraphs: Rocco started the pizzeria with a simple conviction: takeaway pizza has copped an unfair fast-food reputation, and it doesn't have to be that way.
So the pizzas here follow the principles of the Mediterranean diet: a sourdough base, lots of vegetables, good olive oil and honest toppings.
story.quote: Slow-fermented dough, imported tomatoes, fresh basil. No shortcuts. No unnecessary extras.
